description: Reference transitions are changes in radial bins constructed by the Demonstrator, not externally observed dynamical regimes.
requested_sheets=6 produced 7 labels [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] because the maximum radius enters an additional np.digitize boundary bin.
v0.7 KMeans cluster IDs and Demonstrator radial-sheet IDs do not share semantics; validation compares event timing only.
v0.7 embedded windows overlap and may affect persistence and change timing.
Transition samples are sparse enough that the no-change baseline has higher exact sample accuracy despite zero event recall; event precision, recall, and F1 are the relevant comparison metrics.
